The perspective street map remains a recognizable base, while a large detached pin overlaps its upper center as a location modifier.

## Visual draft

A teardrop location pin overlaps the upper center of a perspective map with rounded lower corners. Upright and horizontal street lines divide the map into a grid beneath the pin.

## 1. Perspective street map (solo)

A perspective map narrows toward the top and has rounded bottom corners, with horizontal and upright street divisions. Exclude the location pin.

## 2. Circular center map pin (sub)

A teardrop map pin has a broad round head, small circular center, and pointed base. Exclude the street map.
